story.body: You came off to a full holiday yard already gone. Kemp asked after the rope. Burbage asked after the cold. You said you were well, and you went for the cloak and for Holywell.

relations.quote: I am not writing him a speech for it.

participation.context: Said the yard had been full, and that nobody minds Greenwich, and left the money on the sharers' side.

story.body: You sat the feast. Nick found the bean and made three decrees. Kemp broke the silence at about half a paternoster and did not mind Greenwich. James gave the lease as twenty-one years and two to run, and Cuthbert moved the jug. Heminges reported eleven pound eight to the sharers' side, said Item, and lost a slice to Sam. You did not take the sum home as yours.

relations.quote: One slice of your cake, Master Heminges, for Sam.

relations.note: the jug, when the lease comes up

title: Sat the cake when the bean made Nick king
